data.name: Natalie
data.gender_notes: Natalie is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin natalis, 'birth', specifically dies natalis, the birth of Christ. Its root is Latin natalis. A Christian name given in reference to the Nativity. Natalie is a Latin name meaning “Christmas; birth (of Christ)”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Natalie expresses “Christmas; birth (of Christ)”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin natalis, 'birth', specifically dies natalis, the birth of Christ.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Natalie total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
